(()=>{const log=document.querySelector('.assistant-conversation');const rows=[...log.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-entry')];const last=[...rows].reverse().find(r=>/Course count/.test(r.textContent));if(!last)throw Error('no answered turn in the log');last.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});log.scrollTop=Math.max(0,last.offsetTop-8);return JSON.stringify({entries:rows.length,scrolledTo:last.textContent.slice(0,60)})})()

(()=>{const log=document.querySelector('.assistant-conversation');const t=log.innerText;return JSON.stringify({saysTwoCourses:/Two courses/.test(t),arithmetic:/9.800 . 5.000 = 4.800/.test(t),trap:/ceil(9.8 / 4.8)/.test(t),boundary:/9.800000001 m or more needs at least 3 courses/.test(t)})})()
